nativeGroups.readOrder: Initialize the inherited parameter node before installing Sound-base address points.
Initialize parameter-node state, including absent ranged properties, before installing its address points.
Initialize parent, override bus, fixed properties, state/RTPC storage and embedded identity interfaces.

Read effects first; the forwarded fifth-argument flag skips all remaining bank parameters. Otherwise read metadata, override bus and direct parent identities, flags, fixed/ranged properties, positioning, advanced settings and RTPC/state data. A missing override bus rejects the load; a missing direct parent can leave the node unlinked.
Read override and bounded effect records, allocating native effect storage only for a nonempty record list.
Read the optional metadata record list and allocate only when records are present.
Read fixed and ranged key counts, copy keys and parallel values into separately allocated aligned bundles, and publish each retained pointer. Fixed values use four bytes; ranged values use eight.
Read native override masks and associated optional fields; empty optional sections remain empty.
Read positioning flags and optional path storage; native predicates select the extended branches.
Read advanced flags, auxiliary/effect selection, state data and native optional records.
Read authored RTPC binding records; an empty count does not construct a live controller.
Forward the Sound parameter collection call to the inherited collector and conditionally add the MIDI-dependent pitch contribution.

Collect current node properties and runtime/controller contributions, select override branches, and recurse through a retained parent when present. Current native collection under supplied empty parent/controller state has not been executed by this port.

Walk the fixed property keys and parallel float values. Require key range and output mask, map the key to a native output slot, and add the property value; optional state contributions use the same mapping.
Apply present runtime parameter/controller state; absent state remains a native empty branch.
Apply the separate ranged property bundle under the native selection/PRNG path; this is not exercised by the three fixed-only Sound cohorts.
Resolve auxiliary override selection from the current node and optional inherited parent.
Process changing filter controls through native coefficient interpolation and history; global sub-block settings and retained history are prerequisites.
Collect two fixed filter stages and dispatch their original PCM/history kernel.
Collect the first active fixed filter stage and dispatch its original PCM/history kernel.
Process the second changing filter stage with original coefficients and history.
Process the first changing filter stage with original coefficients and history.
Advance the original classified filter transition state after frame execution.
Map the retained filter control to a sample-rate-limited frequency using the native piecewise approximation.
Execute one coefficient set or a bounded sequence of coefficient sub-blocks through the original single-stage dispatcher.
Select the original single-stage SSE or AVX implementation from the retained CPU kernel selector.
Select the original two-stage SSE or AVX implementation from the retained CPU kernel selector.
Execute the original one-stage sample recurrence and retain per-channel filter history.
Execute the original two-stage sample recurrence and retain both per-channel histories.
Collect matrix/gain inputs for rows whose route filters bypass, then dispatch their matrix/gain accumulation kernel.
Select the original SSE or AVX matrix/gain kernel from the retained selector.
Compute float32 gain/matrix deltas per frame and accumulate original source PCM using unrolled SIMD gain lanes. Terminal target-zero frames retain the original fading tail.
Collect per-channel single-stage history and dispatch the original selected-width AVX filter recurrence.
Collect per-channel two-stage history and dispatch the original selected-width AVX filter recurrence; this is a separate branch from the single-stage cohorts.
Process eight-channel groups or select the remainder-width kernel from the embedded native jump table. The stereo cohort selects its two-channel target.
Process eight-channel groups or select a two-stage remainder-width kernel from the embedded native jump table.
Execute the original two-channel AVX single-stage sample recurrence and retain its channel histories.
Prepare native matrix/gain deltas and dispatch constant or transitioning AVX/FMA accumulation. The zero-target ending frame preserves the original transition.
Use native 32-sample gain lanes, fused gain initialization and FMA sample accumulation, then increment the lane gains once per unrolled block.
Accumulate constant-gain source samples with fused multiply-add into the retained bus PCM.

instructionBindings.meaning: reject property keys above the map range
index the output-slot map with the property key
add fixed float into the mapped output slot
align fixed value start to four bytes
allocate aligned key header plus four bytes per fixed value
nonzero bank-remainder flag bypasses authored parameter reads

evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected installed triplet, full current exception/unwind groups and fully covered leaves, current calls and Sound address-point slots, bank/property instruction operands, property-slot map and width-dispatch table. The authored byte-key map loop explicitly binds its table register/reload, byte load, range, DWORD slot load, ignored slot and original output argument/add/store; the later controller loop is distinct.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Current Sound/parameter construction and bank loaders retain fixed/ranged properties and dispatch the selected property/effect/metadata/position/advanced readers. Current Sound collection calls the base/ranged/fixed/runtime collectors. The authored fixed-property loop reads byte keys and float values, checks its output mask, maps keys to DWORD output slots and adds the scalar value on its checked direct-output branch. Current filter/matrix consumers and SSE/AVX dispatch connect through checked direct/tail targets and the selected width-table branch.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Stored property bundles, masks, slots and consumer transport are bounded native facts; no complete SDK class layout or live resolved parameter set is supplied.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Readable selected Sound/node objects and bank buffers, the checked address points, bank-remainder/override branches, present properties and output masks, native CPU selector and valid filter/matrix state are required. Controller/state paths have separate branches. Historical parameter/filter/PCM cohorts were not rerun or promoted by this static port.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Current evaluated property/filter/matrix/output parity, live authored object association and RTPC/state selection, hierarchy/lifetime, downstream device acceptance and audibility.
